scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix frontend
scripts.dev: concurrently -n "BACKEND,STUDENT,EDUCATOR" -c "blue,magenta,cyan" "npm run dev --prefix backend" "npm run dev:student --prefix frontend" "npm run dev:teacher --prefix frontend"
scripts.dev:student: concurrently -n "BACKEND,STUDENT" -c "blue,magenta" "npm run dev --prefix backend" "npm run dev:student --prefix frontend"
scripts.dev:teacher: concurrently -n "BACKEND,EDUCATOR" -c "blue,cyan" "npm run dev --prefix backend" "npm run dev:teacher --prefix frontend"
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix frontend && npm run build:teacher --prefix frontend
